title: Wireless Power Hardware Manufacturing & Validation
summary: Supported prototype and production-oriented wireless power hardware through PCB assembly, SMT processing, board bring-up, electrical inspection, rework, testing, and verification.
role: Supported builds from assembly and inspection through controlled power-up, troubleshooting, rework, and post-rework verification.
challenge: Build and validate technically demanding electronic assemblies while maintaining repeatable manufacturing and clear verification records.
constraints: Protect proprietary designs and internal measurements
Work across prototype variability and production-readiness needs
process: Review schematics, BOM, and build requirements
Perform SMT assembly and microscope inspection
Complete pre-power checks and controlled power-up
Verify voltage rails and functional behavior
technicalDetails: SMT stencil printing and component placement
lessons: Traceability strengthens both technical and process decisions

title: PCB Failure Analysis & Board Debugging
summary: Structured component-level troubleshooting of electronic assemblies experiencing power, signal, and functional failures.
role: Reviewed expected operation, collected electrical evidence, isolated suspect circuitry, performed corrective rework, and repeated verification.
challenge: Distinguish symptoms from root causes across interconnected power, control, and signal sections without exposing confidential board details.
constraints: No public board names or exact fault values
Avoid secondary damage during isolation and rework
process: Apply controlled power and verify rails
Rework, retest, and document corrective action
outcomes: Created defensible findings from measured evidence
Confirmed corrections through repeated functional testing
lessons: A disciplined sequence reduces false conclusions
Verification must reproduce the original operating conditions
imageAlt: Abstract PCB troubleshooting diagram; authentic approved board image pending

title: AutoBOM Engineering Workflow Platform
summary: A developing engineering operations platform for normalizing BOMs, scaling quantities, improving sourcing workflows, and connecting design, production, and administrative work.
role: Defined workflows, roles, data requirements, and an initial Python-based BOM processing prototype.
challenge: Engineering BOM and purchasing information can become fragmented across spreadsheets, naming conventions, supplier records, and handoffs.
constraints: Integrations remain concepts until implemented and tested
Permissions must reflect real workflow responsibilities
process: Prototype quantity scaling and overage logic
Design broader system architecture and roadmap
technicalDetails: PartsBox, Mouser, and Digi-Key integration concepts
outcomes: Reduced repetitive manual steps in the prototype
Established a scalable architecture for future phases
lessons: Data normalization is foundational to automation
Clear status labels prevent prototypes from being mistaken for production systems
nextSteps: Validate the data model with additional BOM formats

title: Resonant Inductor Development & VNA Testing
summary: Supported the creation, measurement, and refinement of custom inductors and resonant matching networks for wireless power applications.
role: Supported repeatable winding builds, measurement, structured comparison, and capacitor matching investigation.
challenge: Compare inductor builds and resonant behavior while controlling physical construction variables and protecting target specifications.
process: Document core, wire, turn count, and air-gap context
Use VNA data to observe resonance and reflected impedance
Record results and support matching-network refinement
technicalDetails: Ferrite core and Litz wire handling
VNA measurement and capacitor-bank selection context
outcomes: Enabled structured comparison of multiple builds
lessons: Physical construction detail strongly affects electrical behavior
Structured records make iterative hardware work useful

challenge: Create a dependable foundation for repeatable bench automation and clear operator interaction.
